A composite wire is prepared by joining a tungsten wire and steel wire end to end. Both the wires are of the same length and the same area of cross section. If this composite wire is suspended to a rigid support and a force is applied to its free end, it gets extended by 3.25mm. Calculate the increase in length of tungsten wire and steel wire separately.

[Given: \(Y_{steel} = 2 \times 10^{11}\) N/m\(^{2}\), \(Y_{Tungsten} = 3.40 \times 10^{8}\) N/m\(^{2}\)]
bookAnswer: extension in tungsten wire = 3.244 mm, extension in steel wire = 0.0052 mm
_note: TWO defects in this row, both transcribed as printed and NOT repaired. (1) The GIVEN value \(Y_{Tungsten} = 3.40 \times 10^{8}\) N/m\(^{2}\) is unphysical — real tungsten is about \(3.4 \times 10^{11}\) N/m\(^{2}\), i.e. STIFFER than steel, so physically the tungsten wire should extend LESS than the steel one, the opposite of what the printed answer says. An exponent of 11 has been printed as 8. (2) The two printed extensions do not add up to the stated total: 3.244 + 0.0052 = 3.2492, not 3.25. Working from the given data, extension is inversely proportional to Y, so \(l_{t}/l_{s} = Y_{s}/Y_{t} = 588.2\), giving \(l_{s} = 3.25/589.2 = 0.00552\) mm and \(l_{t} = 3.2445\) mm. The tungsten figure is right; the steel figure should be 0.0055 mm, not 0.0052 mm.

stem:
A steel wire having cross sectional area 1.2 mm\(^{2}\) is stretched by a force of 120 N. If a lateral strain of 1.455 mm is produced in the wire, calculate the Poisson's ratio.

[Given: \(Y_{steel} = 2 \times 10^{11}\) N/m\(^{2}\)]
_note: STEM DEFECT, transcribed as printed. 'a lateral strain of 1.455 mm' attaches a unit to a strain, which is a dimensionless ratio. The number is right but the unit is not: the longitudinal strain is \(F/(AY) = 120/(1.2\times10^{-6} \times 2\times10^{11}) = 5 \times 10^{-4}\), and the printed answer 0.291 requires a lateral strain of \(1.455 \times 10^{-4}\) — a pure number. So the stem should read 'a lateral strain of \(1.455 \times 10^{-4}\)'. Read that way, the printed key is exactly right: \(1.455\times10^{-4} / 5\times10^{-4} = 0.291\).
